name: io.github.furkancodes/overlook
title: Overlook
description: Live local dashboards any agent and model can build from your CSV, Parquet, SQLite or Postgres data.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLOOK_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for Overlook's config and saved dashboards (default ~/.overlook)

environmentVariables.name: OVERLOOK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the local dashboard web server (default 4777)

environmentVariables.name: OVERLOOK_OPEN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to stop opening new dashboards in the browser

environmentVariables.name: OVERLOOK_AGENT_SOURCES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to stop the agent from adding data files from the project

environmentVariables.name: OVERLOOK_SAMPLES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to keep sample rows out of what the model sees
